entries.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the Year Edition / current Windows build

primary.version: Game of the Year Edition / current Steam build
primary.why: Sekiro released on PlayStation 4, Windows, Xbox One, and later Stadia. A 2020 update added new content such as cosmetics and a boss-rush mode, and the current Windows build is the route. Since Stadia is discontinued and no platform-exclusive story content exists elsewhere, Windows is the highest-fidelity complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows Steam build / Game of the Year Edition. Confirm patch level before capture and ignore the discontinued Stadia route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged. Stadia is discontinued.
